description: This Python script generates a header for a file, calculates MD5 hashes for parts of this header, combines them into a key, and saves the key to a file. It is involved in creating cryptographic headers and keys, likely for use in encryption or secure data handling.

methods.name: create_header(key, version, iv, random, size)
methods.description: Creates a structured header with provided key, version, iv, random, and size fields.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads an input file, generates a header, computes MD5 hashes to create a key, and writes header and key to files.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command line arguments and orchestrates the execution of create_output.
